roundaboutCaveat.note: 3834[2->4] is a roundabout arc, literally coincident with 25602[0->2]. flokalundur->isafjordur traverses it in 3834's own forward direction; isafjordur->flokalundur traverses it AGAINST that direction. The core does not split a line into direction-dependent portions, so no directed policy rule is applied -- the correct-direction arc would be longer (approximately 62.45 m, about 23 m more); this is a visible MVP caveat, not corrected in this round.
